name: visual-readout-v1
comparison: Hold the qualified spatial sensory overlay fixed. Compare original all-cell readout, directly annotated visual-cell spatial readout, and its side/type-stratified shuffle.
geometry: 23,565 directly annotated visual cells within the original sensory bounds; exclude 155 out-of-bounds cells. Sixty board points, eight seeded type channels, 176 empty groups. Same selected cells and all pool counts in the spatial/shuffled pair.

qualification: Full-graph V0 states, losses, every gradient and three free-running updates pass the independent JAX CPU reference for both new port maps at rate 0.01. Original tolerances retained. The first harness attempt used the wrong Adam step index and is retained separately.
execution: Start independently after each registered schedule validation releases its CPU lane. Use the same immutable c149278eda30697520f9 learner source as the schedule screen; no new forward equation.
selection: All three final checkpoints at the declared horizon, full natural/novel validation and diagnostics. No test labels or best-step selection; seed-1 evidence requires later confirmation.
